mapper.select: SELECT job_table.company, COUNT(*) AS count FROM action_table join job_table on job_table.id = action_table.job_id and action_table.delivered = 1 GROUP BY job_table.company ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 4

SELECT job_table.jd_title FROM action_table,job_table,favor where job_table.id = action_table.job_id and (action_table.delivered = 1 or favor.job_id = job_table.id) GROUP BY job_table.jd_title ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5
